card.name: Inside Arabic names and script
card.fires_on: Partway through transliterated Arabic names and titles (after Al-, As-, Ar-) and inside Arabic-script words in dictionary translation lists. It fires on the letters inside these words, not on ordinary English.

modes.label: Transliterated Arabic titles
modes.description: Letters or hyphenated parts right after Al-, As- or Ar- inside Arabic book titles and phrases.

modes.label: Arabic script words
